zh.evening: 晚上好，整理今天的收获
zh.subtitle: 对话、任务和用量，一眼掌握。
zh.totalHint: 本机有任务记录的对话，含归档，不含子智能体
zh.tasksHint: 昨日发起过任务的独立对话数
zh.tokensHint: 输入＋输出，含缓存输入与子智能体
zh.todayHint: 今天发起过任务的独立对话数
zh.loading: 正在读取本机历史，首次可能需要一些时间…
zh.unavailable: 历史统计暂不可用，可稍后点击右上角刷新。
zh.partial: 部分历史无法读取，带 ≥ 的数字为已读取部分；统计可能不完整。
zh.activityHint: 按本地自然日统计，同一对话一天内只计一次。
zh.quotaLoading: 正在读取当前账户额度…
zh.noQuotaProvider: 暂无可用额度来源。启用并登录 Codex 订阅插件后可显示订阅额度。
zh.quotaError: 暂时无法读取额度，请检查订阅登录与连接；这不代表额度为零。
zh.quotaEmpty: 当前账户没有返回可显示的额度窗口。
zh.noRecent: 还没有可显示的对话，开始你的第一个任务吧。
zh.allClear: 现在可以专注做点新事了
zh.allClearHint: 当前没有正在运行或等待你处理的任务。
zh.scope: 统计来自本机 DSH 记录，昨日按本机时区计算；— 表示尚未读取或未报告用量。
zh.usagePartial: 部分请求未报告完整用量；昨日 Token 若带 ≥，表示已知消耗下限。

en.evening: Good evening. Make room for ideas.
en.subtitle: Your conversations, tasks and usage at a glance.
en.totalHint: Local conversations with task history, including archived; excludes subagents
en.tasksHint: Distinct conversations with a task started yesterday
en.tokensHint: Input + output, including cached input and subagents
en.todayHint: Distinct conversations with a task started today
en.loading: Reading local history. The first read may take a moment…
en.unavailable: History statistics are unavailable. Try the refresh button later.
en.partial: Some history could not be read. Values marked ≥ are partial counts.
en.activityHint: Local calendar days. Each conversation is counted once per day.
en.noQuotaProvider: No quota source is available. Enable and sign in to Codex Subscription to show its allowance.
en.quotaError: Allowance is unavailable. Check your subscription sign-in and connection; this does not mean zero quota.
en.quotaEmpty: This account did not report any displayable quota windows.
en.continue: PICK UP WHERE YOU LEFT OFF
en.noRecent: No conversations yet. Start your first task.
en.allClear: A little room for your next idea
en.allClearHint: No tasks are currently running or waiting for your input.
en.scope: Local DSH records and calendar days in your device’s time zone. — means not loaded or usage not reported.
en.usagePartial: Some requests did not report complete usage. Yesterday’s tokens marked ≥ are a known lower bound.
